interfaces.name: USB-C host interface
interfaces.description: USB 2.0 device/sink interface for probe power, native ESP32-S3 USB data, ESD protection, resettable VBUS protection, and a replaceable shield-to-ground strategy.

interfaces.name: Target debug interface J2
interfaces.description: Tag-Connect TC2050-IDC-NL 10-pin Plug-of-Nails target interface carrying VTREF, GND, SWDIO, SWCLK, NRST, BOOT0, target UART TX and target UART RX.

interfaces.name: Target debug interface J3
interfaces.description: Keyed JST-XH B8B-XH-A (LF)(SN) field connector carrying the same eight nets as J2; J2 and J3 are alternatives and only one target may be connected.

interfaces.name: Expansion interface J4
interfaces.description: Trusted internal seven-pin 3V3/GND/GPIO10/GPIO11/GPIO12/GPIO13/GPIO14 development header; not hot-pluggable and limited to 25 mA total 3V3 load.

rails.name: USB_5V
rails.description: Protected USB input rail for the buck regulator.

rails.name: 3V3
rails.description: Probe-local AP63203 regulated rail; it must never power the target connector.

rails.name: VTREF
rails.description: Target-provided reference only, supported from 3.0 V through 3.6 V and used for sensing, BOOT0 sourcing, and the enable supervisor only.

connectors.purpose: USB-C USB 2.0 device/sink receptacle; exact footprint including locating holes and shield slots is required.
DNL PCB contact footprint for the 10-pin Tag-Connect Plug-of-Nails cable; pin order is authoritative in config/design-data.json.
Keyed JST-XH 2.5 mm vertical 1x8 target connector; pin order is authoritative in config/design-data.json.

mechanical.board_outline: 44 mm × 70 mm four-layer rectangular board with no mounting holes. U1 is centered at the top short edge with its antenna section beyond the board outline; J1 occupies the left portion of the bottom short edge with its documented footprint PCB-edge datum aligned to the outline; J2 and J3 face outward from the long edges.
mechanical.placement_intent: ESP32-S3 module is at the top short edge with antenna facing outward. USB-C is at the bottom-left short edge so its protected data pair can use the reviewed left-side corridor; controls remain accessible along the lower area and the buck converter stays in the lower-right power island. Target connectors run along the long edges; do not place components, copper, fasteners, or enclosure metal in the module antenna keepout.

constraints.name: controller
constraints.description: Use ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8. GPIO3, GPIO35, GPIO36, GPIO37, GPIO45, and GPIO46 are unavailable for product functions.

constraints.name: operating-mode
constraints.description: The ESP32-S3 operates as a Wi-Fi-connected, standalone remote programmer. A PC is not required during target programming; firmware behavior is outside the PCB authority but its assigned pins and the target interface contract are hardware constraints.

constraints.name: target-scope
constraints.description: Rev A.1 is initially intended for STM32 targets using SWD, NRST, BOOT0, and target UART. Future target-family expansion must preserve the documented J2/J3 pin contract or be introduced as a separately reviewed revision.

constraints.name: power-boundary
constraints.description: The probe is USB powered only. It has no target-power output and must not connect VTREF directly to probe 3V3 or USB_5V.

constraints.name: target-voltage-policy
constraints.description: TMUX-carried SWD/UART paths are enabled only for validated VTREF in the 3.0–3.6 V range, with hardware supervisor interlock plus firmware ADC validation, hysteresis, debounce, and immediate disable on invalid voltage. NRST and BOOT0 have safe passive defaults but are firmware-gated rather than U5 hardware-gated.

constraints.name: signal-isolation
constraints.description: Use TMUX1574PWR as a four-channel switch, not a level translator. SWDIO is bidirectional. The target interface must remain safe when either target or probe is unpowered.

constraints.name: usb-routing
constraints.description: USB D+/D− requires a 90-ohm differential controlled-impedance design on F.Cu over continuous In1.Cu ground, no layer change after ESD, matched topology, and minimal skew. Final geometry must come from reviewed JLCPCB evidence, not this requirement record.

constraints.name: switching-layout
constraints.description: Keep the AP63203 VIN-SW-L1-COUT-GND loop compact, SW copper small, and USB, antenna, VTREF, SWD, and UART outside the switch region.

constraints.name: usb-power-budget
constraints.description: No USB PD or Type-C current-advertisement detection is fitted. Worst-case 5 V input current, including startup and conversion loss, must remain at or below 500 mA; J4 may consume at most 25 mA from 3V3.

constraints.name: target-interface-performance
constraints.description: Validate target cables through 300 mm, SWD through 4 MHz, UART through 3 Mbit/s, and system-level IEC 61000-4-2 ±8 kV contact and ±15 kV air discharge at exposed target connectors.

constraints.name: manufacturing
constraints.description: First prototype target is JLCPCB four-layer PCB plus SMT assembly, initially in a 5-10 board prototype quantity. Routing and release require separately reviewed process values.

constraints.name: feature-retention
constraints.description: Both J2 and J3 target interfaces, the expansion header, LEDs, and buttons are required in Rev A.1; do not simplify them away to ease routing without an explicit product revision.

critical_nets.purpose: USB 2.0 D+ connector-side path into U2 I/O1
USB 2.0 D− connector-side path into U2 I/O2
USB 2.0 D+ protected differential path from U2 I/O1 to R4
USB 2.0 D− protected differential path from U2 I/O2 to R5
Target reference sensing and hardware interlock
Active-low target switch enable guarded by the VTREF supervisor

placement_regions.name: antenna-edge
placement_regions.description: Top short edge: ESP32-S3 antenna and full keepout.

placement_regions.name: usb-power
placement_regions.description: Bottom short edge: USB-C, ESD, VBUS protection and buck converter; keep switching loop local.

placement_regions.name: target-interfaces
placement_regions.description: Long edges: J2/J3 with dedicated, connector-adjacent ESD banks.

placement_regions.name: signal-control
placement_regions.description: Center/lower board: TMUX, supervisor, reset/BOOT0 controls, LEDs, buttons, and expansion header.
